en-US.description: Spec-first continuity framework for AI-assisted development
en-US.longDescription: Anchors ties spec, feature and test together through a shared identity code, then confronts each artifact against the rules declared in anchors.yaml. It maps the project as a graph, propagates change from the anchor outward, and gates every step — so work guided by AI stays anchored to what was decided.
en-US.name: Anchors
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fix: a stage's last job is anchors pipeline record
shellcheck, run on every workflow by actionlint, read anchors pipeline done <stage> as the end
of a shell loop and reported SC1010 on each workflow that calls it (MIF).
The command that runs a stage's verify: and records its outcome is now anchors pipeline record <stage>. done stays as an alias, so a workflow already written with it still runs. The
pipeline-wired gate reads record, done and run as a stage's record.
Everything in the v0.1.351 notes still applies: run anchors migrate once, crossing format 8.
Changelog
- 5ff184c fix(pipeline): the stage's last job is pipeline record, with done as its alias
